coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Seventeen attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject 8303142d at 0444 unmoved with dispatch and prompt agreeing, HEAD never left 665415a, file 08 at 3a9442d1 equal to the subject's own pin, governing tree clean, and all cited digests reproduce. Coverage is the part I tested hardest, because every finding in this leftover-join series has come from enumerating a pinned source's own inventory, and I have missed four such enumerations while catching one. I enumerated four inventories before reading the subject's account of any of them. Doctor v4 carries twelve FC classes and the artifact's classIds and namedClassesNotAuthored are both set-equal to them. v8 carries thirteen join fixture classes and the count and standing match. v8's remainingNamedNotResolved carries seven items and all seven are classified — FC-C1 and BLK-1..4 riding DR-105 per D-163, fixture execution at G09, D-096 (A) unminted, the later CA-2 decision unminted, CA-1 IN_PROCESS unexercisable, and doctor v4's ID-DEP-12 with its own obligation rather than a mention inside someone else's reason. The empirical zero-claims reproduce: neither contract catalogues a single fixture path, so the audit's zeros for implementations, paths and digests are true, and the hex values in both are input pins rather than fixture bytes. Two defect classes this corpus produced very recently are both absent: the member is keyed leftoverDesignOpenStanding rather than the contradictory leftoverDesignOpenIsAFinding, and no unmet-list item is omitted. BLK-5 appears once as a discharge recital and BLK-6 and BLK-7 not at all, so none is treated as leftover. Fifteen obligations partition cleanly across six groups. I probed the one placement that could be an overreach — join-fixture execution at G09 — and it follows v8's own words that execution remains at DR-G09, with G09's live claim genuinely fitting classes like doctor-consent-is-not-a-grant. Two things for your attention rather than as findings. First, a separate artifact for the same row, doctor-actor-leftover-join.v1 at 07d4ac42, is live on disk at 0444 with no verdict from either reviewer; it is not a version of this one, and I reviewed only the subject this dispatch named. Second, doctor-contract.v4.json is mode 0644 where v6, v8 and v25 are 0444 — not this candidate's doing and its digest reproduces, but after Codex's D-163 verdict-mode finding a corpus-wide custody sweep may be worth scheduling.
